text:
maya: FYI planning to publish py+ts SDK canary to npm/pypi during the 1600 PT change window. will need pin guidance and a short rollback playbook.
chris: timeline ok for me — we should cut canary tag first and wait ~30m for telemetry.
release-bot: Release candidate artifacts built: packages/sdks/py-0.13.0-rc1.tar.gz, packages/sdks/ts-0.13.0-rc1.tgz
maya: Notes: bump is a minor (feature + deprecate old sync client) so semver -> 0.13.0. add deprecation header in changelog and include migration snippet.
rachel: For PyPI use build + twine, also fix long_description metadata. commands:
```
python -m build
twine upload --repository pypi dist/*
```
chris: NPM steps for TS:
```
npm publish dist --tag canary
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.13.0 canary
```
maya: Also add pinned-versions section to README and create an advisory for Dedicated customers who pin to 0.12.x — we shouldn't auto-upgrade them.
devex-jeff: Ping @support and @account-management about staging docs and scheduling the deprecation notice; we should avoid surprises for enterprise customers.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started on infra-canary-1. Canary endpoints: https://canary.api.redwood.com
maya: After 45m, check error rate, latency p50/p95, and token-cost regression. if error rate > 1% revert canary and rollback artifacts.
chris: Initial metrics look good, 0.1% errors, p95 within SLO. will monitor for next 30m then widen to staged.
rachel: Small doc edit: add migration snippet for async client usage and callouts for users still on sync client.
maya: Decision: proceed to staged tag after stability. Publish to npm as 'latest' only after staged passes and we've updated changelog. hold final PyPI publish until changelog + release notes merged.
chris: I'll draft release notes and deprecation paragraph now. will ping for review.
maya: Confirmed pins for Dedicated customers: create PR that adds "pinned-versions.md" and annotate rollout policies per customer.
rachel: Emergency revert playbook (if public publish causes issues):
- npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.12.9 latest
- npm deprecate @redwood/sdk@0.13.0 "Broken release, please pin to 0.12.9"
- PyPI: yank 0.13.0 if necessary and republish 0.12.9 as advised
- rollback infra changes via deploy-bot revert command
:warning: use Customer Support escalation for Dedicated accounts.
maya: Acknowledged. We'll keep the rollback playbook pinned in the thread and attach the final release notes before public announcement. :thumbsup:
chris: tagging this thread with #release-playbook and will post a short note to #general once final publish is done.
rachel: I'll queue the docs PR and the deprecation banner in the docs site.
maya: Thanks all — moving to staged canary now. will post updates here with telemetry snapshots every 15m.
